'''Family Walkers''' were a model of [[Walker/Legends|walker]] commonly used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Emmer]]. FAmily Walkers were variants of the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] and aimed at providing the travels need of family units.<ref name="E" />
